{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The current Administration has promoted the notion of abortion as healthcare.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Numerous studies have shown that abortion endangers the health and wellbeing of women.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"We stand firmly against abortion.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Taking care of one's health is an individual responsibility.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Chronic diseases, many of them related to lifestyle, drive healthcare costs, accounting for more than 75 percent of the nation's medical spending.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"To reduce demand and thereby lower costs, we must foster personal responsibility while increasing preventive services to promote healthy lifestyles.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"All Americans should have improved access to affordable, coordinated, quality healthcare, including individuals struggling with mental illness.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
